annotations.title: Draft a sign-up sheet from the user's words

description: Turn the user's email, notes, flyer text or description of their event into a link that opens im-in.events with those words in the Describe it box. Pressing Make my draft there builds the whole sign-up sheet (dates, times, place, every role with its count, waitlist, reminders and its look) for the user to check and publish. Creates nothing and needs no account.

words.description: The user's own words about the event, as complete as they gave them
